# Wasilah

> Wasilah is a free Islamic companion app for Muslims in Bangladesh and Bengali-speaking Muslims worldwide. It brings together accurate local prayer times, Adhan, Qibla direction, step-by-step Salah and Wudu guides, Quran, Hadith, duas, the 99 Names of Allah, a Zakat calculator in Bangladeshi Taka, a Hajj and Umrah guide, and Wasilah Deen Intelligence. Live on the App Store and Google Play. Built by Aykiz Intelligence.

Key facts:

- Free to download and use. No paywalls, and the app will never be monetized.
- Available in English, Bangla, and Arabic.
- Designed for Bangladesh: dynamic local prayer times, Jumu'ah shown on Fridays, Zakat calculated in BDT, and full Bangla content for Quran, Hadith, and duas.
- Works offline-first. Prayer times and Qibla are computed on-device.
- Teaches worship, not just times: a step-by-step Salah guide covering the full method of all five daily prayers and Witr, plus Sajdah Sahw, and a step-by-step Wudu guide covering the four Fard actions in the Hanafi method. Both in Bangla, Arabic and English.
- Wasilah Deen Intelligence: ask about salah, fasting, duas, the Quran or daily practice and get answers with references to the source. Questions that need a personal ruling are not guessed at, they are pointed to a qualified scholar. Three questions a day, free for everyone, funded by the publisher rather than by ads. It is one of only two parts of the app that need an internet connection, the other being Quran recitation audio, which streams.
- Also includes an Apple Watch companion, Ramadan and Hijri calendar, and sehri and iftar times.
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767919573
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=site.wasilah.wasilah
- Publisher: Aykiz Intelligence (https://aykizintelligence.com/), the studio of Miraz Mullick.
- Contact: hello@wasilah.site (general and support), privacy@wasilah.site (privacy), legal@wasilah.site (legal).

## FAQ

Q: Is Wasilah free?
A: Yes. Wasilah is free to download and use, with no ads anywhere in the app, no sign-up and no paywall, and it will never be monetized.

Q: What does Wasilah include?
A: Accurate local prayer times, Adhan, Qibla direction, the full Quran, Hadith, duas, the 99 Names of Allah, a Zakat calculator in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT), and a Hajj and Umrah guide.

Q: What languages does Wasilah support?
A: English, Bangla, and Arabic, with full Bangla content for Quran, Hadith, and duas.

Q: Who is Wasilah for?
A: Muslims in Bangladesh and Bengali-speaking Muslims worldwide. It is designed for Bangladesh, with dynamic local prayer times, Jumu'ah shown on Fridays, and Zakat in BDT.

Q: Does Wasilah work offline?
A: Yes. Prayer times and Qibla are computed on-device and work offline once your location is set; Quran, Hadith, duas, the 99 Names, and the guides are bundled in the app. Audio recitation streams, so that part needs a connection.

Q: What data does Wasilah collect?
A: Nothing about your worship is collected. Your location is used on-device to compute prayer times and Qibla and is not sent anywhere. The iPhone build carries no third-party SDK; the Android build sends Meta an install and app-open signal for ad attribution and nothing else. See https://wasilah.site/privacy/.

Q: How do I download Wasilah?
A: Free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767919573) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=site.wasilah.wasilah), or via https://wasilah.site/get/.
